n2aa07da3b7d.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the demographic indicators of Andhra Pradesh?
o: Krishna district recorded the highest population density, at 518 persons per sq km
The sex ratio of Andhra Pradesh was 997
The literacy rate of Andhra Pradesh was higher than the national literacy rate
The sex ratio of India was 943
n2aa07da3b7d.x: AP literacy (67.35%) was below India's 72.98%, so this statement is false; the density of Krishna (518) and the sex ratios (AP 997, India 943) are correct.

nef46f44dcfe.s:
Assertion (A): Andhra Pradesh ranked first in egg production, with 2,739 crore eggs.
Reason (R): Andhra Pradesh ranked seventh in milk production, with 139.46 lakh MT.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nef46f44dcfe.x: AP ranked first in eggs (2,739 crore) and seventh in milk (139.46 lakh MT); both are true, but the milk ranking does not explain the egg ranking.

n0e587283b45.s: As per the Census 2011-based indicators, the population density of Andhra Pradesh is:
n0e587283b45.x: Andhra Pradesh (area 1,62,970 sq km) has a density of 304 persons per sq km; 382 is the India-level density.

n28a2ebe4838.s: As per the 2025-26 FAE, the growth rate of Andhra Pradesh's agriculture and allied sector was:
n28a2ebe4838.x: AP's agriculture and allied sector grew 10.14% (India 3.1%); 9.15% is AP's industry and 10.67% its services growth.

n7bbbd2aa1ff.s: As per PLFS 2023-24 (all ages), the unemployment rate of Andhra Pradesh was:
n7bbbd2aa1ff.x: For all ages in 2023-24, AP's unemployment rate was 4.1%, with LFPR 47.5% and WPR 45.6%.

n4fe778ed65d.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the infrastructure commitments in the Thirteenth Schedule of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014?
o: Feasibility study of a SAIL steel plant in Kurnool district
Feasibility study of a Vizag-Chennai industrial corridor
The Vizag-Chennai corridor to be modelled on the Delhi-Mumbai Industrial Corridor
n4fe778ed65d.x: The SAIL steel plant feasibility study is for YSR district, not Kurnool; the Duggirajupatnam port and the DMIC-modelled Vizag-Chennai corridor study are correct.

n3610bdd5251.s:
Assertion (A): After reorganisation, Andhra Pradesh has 25 Lok Sabha seats and Telangana has 17.
Reason (R): Andhra Pradesh has 175 Legislative Assembly seats and Telangana has 119.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n3610bdd5251.x: Both seat distributions are correct (Lok Sabha 25 and 17; Assembly 175 and 119), but the Assembly figures do not explain the Lok Sabha figures.

n41f2d37034e.s: Under Section 85 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014, the Krishna River Management Board has its headquarters in:
n41f2d37034e.x: Section 85 places the KRMB in Andhra Pradesh and the Godavari River Management Board in Telangana.

n1f85d2e4c69.s: Under Section 105 of the AP Reorganisation Act, disputes over the transfer of pending cases were finally decided by:
n1f85d2e4c69.x: Section 105 sent disputes on transferring pending cases to the Hyderabad High Court, whose decision was final.

n424a7871aa6.s: Section 18 of the AP Reorganisation Act allowed each Governor to nominate one Anglo-Indian MLA under Article:
n424a7871aa6.x: Section 18 provided for one nominated Anglo-Indian member in each Assembly under Article 333 (the provision was later ended by the 104th Amendment).

n3764e766024.s: Under Schedule XI of the AP Reorganisation Act, ____ is given precedence over irrigation.
n3764e766024.x: Schedule XI gives drinking water precedence over irrigation, and irrigation precedence over power.

nd9b799b683c.s:
Assertion (A): Under the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014, assets and commercial undertakings (Section 53) are divided by population ratio.
Reason (R): Treasury and bank cash balances (Section 49) are divided by population ratio.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nd9b799b683c.x: Assets and commercial undertakings go by location under Section 53, so A is false; cash balances under Section 49 do go by population ratio, so R is true.

nb36ff388e50.s: Which Section of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 provides for a common Governor for both States?
nb36ff388e50.x: Section 7 provides for a common Governor; Section 3 forms Telangana, Section 5 makes Hyderabad the common capital and Section 6 sets up the expert committee.

n089bd0992c7.s: The Indian Institute of Petroleum and Energy in Andhra Pradesh was set up by an Act of:
n089bd0992c7.x: IIPE was set up by an Act of 2017; the Central Tribal University came through the Central Universities (Amendment) Act, 2019.

n2bbf1f750a7.s: Which Finance Commission removed the distinction between special and general category States in tax devolution?
n2bbf1f750a7.x: The Fourteenth Finance Commission (2015) removed the special/general distinction; AP then got special packages instead of SCS.

n0aa72608a49.s: Which Section of the AP Reorganisation Act provides grants and a special development package for backward areas, especially Rayalaseema and the north coastal districts?
n0aa72608a49.x: Section 46 covers successor-state resources, grants and a special development package with particular attention to Rayalaseema and the north coastal districts.

n8d1ee79a2c9.s: How much was disbursed under Section 94(3) of the AP Reorganisation Act as special support for the new capital?
n8d1ee79a2c9.x: ₹2,500 crore was disbursed under Section 94(3) for the new capital (Raj Bhavan, High Court, Secretariat, Assembly, Council).

nd15db220d2a.s: The AIIMS set up in Andhra Pradesh under the AP Reorganisation Act is located at:
nd15db220d2a.x: AIIMS is at Mangalagiri; NIT is at Tadepalligudem, IIT at Tirupati and IIM at Visakhapatnam.

nc5ae39f5fd7.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about power sharing under the Twelfth Schedule of the AP Reorganisation Act?
o: Central Generating Station power is shared on the DISCOMs' actual consumption over the last five years
Power from APGENCO plants is allocated by population ratio
Andhra Pradesh got about 46 per cent of the power
Andhra Pradesh had about 58 per cent of the population
nc5ae39f5fd7.x: APGENCO plants are divided by location (with existing PPAs continuing), not by population ratio; the other statements are correct.

ncfc31d54f75.s:
Assertion (A): More than 140 corporations and institutions, valued at over Rs 39,000 crore, remain undivided between AP and Telangana.
Reason (R): Telangana supports dividing them exclusively on the population ratio.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ncfc31d54f75.x: A is true; R is false because Telangana insists on a location basis, while AP seeks the 58:42 population ratio.

nc4bc02962f4.s: The Pratyush Sinha Committee dealt with the allocation of:
o: Assets and liabilities of Schedule IX companies
nc4bc02962f4.x: Pratyush Sinha handled All India Services officers; Kamalanathan handled State-level employees and Sheela Bhide handled Schedule IX companies and corporations.

ncff5a17354b.s: Under the AP Reorganisation Act, arrears of taxes other than property taxes are divided on the basis of:
ncff5a17354b.x: Section 50 divides arrears of other taxes by place of assessment; refunds of such taxes follow the population ratio.

n633e81fce5c.s: Which Section of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 creates separate State cadres of the IAS, IPS and IFoS?
n633e81fce5c.x: Section 76 creates separate AIS cadres under the 1954/1966 Cadre Rules; Section 77 deals with State employees.

n26029cbf620.s: Andhra Pradesh invokes which Section of the AP Reorganisation Act to bring unscheduled institutions into Schedule IX or X?
n26029cbf620.x: AP invokes Section 66 to bring institutions not in any Schedule into Schedule IX or X.

n18b063d7312.s: Under the Twelfth Schedule, Telangana's equity share in Singareni Collieries Company Limited is:
n18b063d7312.x: Telangana holds 51 per cent and the Government of India 49 per cent of SCCL; Andhra Pradesh holds none.

n9efc82cd5a7.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Special Category Status and the Special Assistance Measure?
o: Andhra Pradesh has argued that the Special Assistance Measure has statutory permanence
Special Category Status was promised on the floor of Parliament for five years
The Centre cited the Fourteenth Finance Commission while denying Special Category Status
Under the Special Assistance Measure, the Centre funds the 90 per cent grant equivalent only for Externally Aided Projects
n9efc82cd5a7.x: AP argues that the Special Assistance Measure lacks statutory permanence, so the first statement is false; the others are correct.

nd6f46831124.s:
Assertion (A): Arrears of property tax or land revenue are divided according to the State where the property lies.
Reason (R): Refunds of other taxes collected in excess are divided by population ratio.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nd6f46831124.x: Both are true (property arrears follow the property's location; other-tax refunds follow population), but the refund rule does not explain the property rule.

n60232e57af3.s: Under Section 55 of the AP Reorganisation Act, floating loans not raised for one particular State are divided by:
n60232e57af3.x: Section 55 keeps a floating loan with the State for whose purposes it was raised and divides the rest by population ratio.

ncdac08171af.s: The Fourteenth Finance Commission raised the States' share in the divisible pool from 32 per cent to:
ncdac08171af.x: The Fourteenth FC (2015-20) raised the States' share from 32 to 42 per cent and removed the general/special category distinction.

nfec327ea300.s: Under the criticised apportionment arrangement, Andhra Pradesh took what share of the debt?
nfec327ea300.x: Debt was divided by population, so AP took 58%, while it received only 46% of revenue assets allocated by location.

n9947b23345d.s: Andhra Pradesh claimed that its true 2014-15 resource gap was about:
n9947b23345d.x: AP claimed about Rs 16,078 crore, whereas the Centre's standardised calculation gave about Rs 4,117.89 crore.

n21a3154d5f5.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the choice of Andhra Pradesh's capital?
o: The Capital City Advisory Committee was chaired by P. Narayana
P. Narayana was the Municipal Administration Minister
The final decision to locate the capital at Amaravati was taken by the Central Government
The Capital City Advisory Committee backed the Vijayawada-Guntur region
n21a3154d5f5.x: The AP Cabinet, not the Centre, chose Amaravati; the committee chaired by Municipal Administration Minister P. Narayana backed the Vijayawada-Guntur region.

n3c3f3dcbe37.s: The Andhra Pradesh Government estimated the cost of building the new capital at about:
n3c3f3dcbe37.x: The State estimated about Rs 1.2 lakh crore, while the Centre's commitment was only about Rs 27,000 crore.

n02137a8e942.s: Which provision of the AP Reorganisation Act provides special central support for the Raj Bhavan, High Court, Secretariat and Legislature of the new capital?
n02137a8e942.x: Section 94(3) covers the Raj Bhavan, High Court, Secretariat, Legislative Assembly, Legislative Council and other essential infrastructure.

neb9d1d93580.s: Section 94(4) of the AP Reorganisation Act deals with:
o: Constitution of the expert committee on the capital
Denotification of degraded forest land for the capital, if required
neb9d1d93580.x: Section 94(4) provides for denotifying degraded forest land for the capital; Section 5 is the common capital and Section 6 the expert committee.

ndf7386f7122.s: The Expert Committee under Section 6 of the AP Reorganisation Act had to submit its report within:
ndf7386f7122.x: The committee, constituted by the Centre, had to report within six months; it opposed a single super capital.

nfd3df2452c2.s: Which law made Amaravati the sole capital of Andhra Pradesh?
o: AP Decentralisation and Inclusive Development of All Regions Act, 2020
nfd3df2452c2.x: The APRA (Amendment) Act, 2026 made Amaravati the sole capital, alongside ₹15,000 crore of fast-tracked central assistance.

n4de8ddbe50d.s: The Green Energy Corridor Phase-I in Andhra Pradesh is supported by:
n4de8ddbe50d.x: Green Energy Corridor Phase-I is funded by KfW; APIIATP is a World Bank project and SAPAP is supported by UNDP.

n324b5f797af.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 2015 tax incentives under Section 94(1) of the AP Reorganisation Act?
o: Additional depreciation of 35% on new plant and machinery
They applied only to the notified backward districts of AP and not to Telangana
Investment allowance of 15% on new plant and machinery
They applied to units set up between 1 April 2015 and 31 March 2020
n324b5f797af.x: The incentives covered notified backward districts of both AP and Telangana; the 35% depreciation, 15% allowance and 2015-2020 window are correct.

n33b0856cff1.s:
Assertion (A): The Visakhapatnam Economic Region covers 10 districts and was launched on 13 November 2025.
Reason (R): The Visakhapatnam Economic Region was launched by NITI Aayog under the Aspirational Districts Programme.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n33b0856cff1.x: A is correct; R is false because VER is a region-specific growth plan, not part of NITI Aayog's Aspirational Districts Programme.

n0ee4528bb58.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Aspirational Districts Programme launched by – Finance Commission
n0ee4528bb58.x: The Aspirational Districts Programme was launched by NITI Aayog, not the Finance Commission; the other pairs are correct.

n8d8e47a423f.s: The backward districts package for Andhra Pradesh provides each covered district:
n8d8e47a423f.x: The package gives Rs 50 crore per district per year to seven districts (4 Rayalaseema + 3 North Coastal), i.e. Rs 350 crore in all.

n0ae08a303a6.s: Andhra Pradesh argues post-bifurcation transfers fell short of the 14th and 15th FC recommendations and the Prime Minister's assurances given in:
n0ae08a303a6.x: AP maintains transfers fell short of the Fourteenth and Fifteenth FC recommendations and the PM's assurances in the Rajya Sabha.

n85413108df2.s: On the revised cost estimate of the Polavaram project, the Centre caps its liability at:
n85413108df2.x: The Centre caps its liability at old price levels, and rehabilitation and resettlement costs also remain disputed.

n51fef7f14dc.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Kottavalasa-Kirandul (K-K) line dispute?
o: Andhra Pradesh leaders offered the entire line to Odisha without reservation
Odisha claimed the entire K-K line
The Centre favoured moving the entire K-K line to the new Rayagada division
AP leaders offered stretches such as Koraput-Kirandul to Odisha
n51fef7f14dc.x: AP leaders offered only the Odisha stretches (Koraput-Kirandul, Kuneru-Theruvali, Koraput-Rayagada), not the entire line.

n00c93bc9d1e.s: The South Coast Railway zone became fully operational on:
n00c93bc9d1e.x: SCoR, announced in 2019, was gazetted on 4 May 2026 and became fully operational on 1 June 2026.

n4edaf7941cc.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the proposed Dugarajapatnam port and shipbuilding cluster?
o: Its SPV is a 50:50 JV of the Visakhapatnam Port Authority and AP Maritime Board
Andhra Pradesh is the only State selected for a national shipbuilding cluster
The cluster is estimated to be worth ₹30,000 crore
n4edaf7941cc.x: It is one of five national cluster sites (others in Tamil Nadu, Gujarat, Odisha and Maharashtra); the other statements are correct.

n3360c87cf6e.s:
Assertion (A): Under the Thirteenth Schedule, the NIDM campus was promised for Telangana.
Reason (R): A Tribal University was promised in each of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n3360c87cf6e.x: NIDM was promised for AP (Southern Campus at Kondapalli), so A is false; a Tribal University in each State is correct.

nba20f3c0f16.s: The JSW Rayalaseema Integrated Steel Plant in Kadapa is to draw 2 tmc ft of water a year from:
nba20f3c0f16.x: The scrap-based EAF plant (Rs 16,350 crore) is to draw 2 tmc ft a year from Gandikota.

n3a7548ba6ed.s: The integrated steel plant committed in the Thirteenth Schedule is associated with:
n3a7548ba6ed.x: The steel plant is linked to YSR Kadapa; the refinery and petrochemical complex is linked to the Kakinada region.

nb55abadc8cb.s: Which of the following was NOT among the Thirteenth Schedule institutions proposed for Andhra Pradesh?
nb55abadc8cb.x: The list included an IIT, NIT, IIM, IISER, IIIT and several universities, but no National Institute of Fashion Technology.

n8918b497cd6.s: The Vizag-Chennai Industrial Corridor (VCIC) is funded by:
n8918b497cd6.x: VCIC is an ADB-funded project, whose progress has been slow.

n1bee492ced0.s: The Central University of Andhra Pradesh is located at:
n1bee492ced0.x: CUAP is at Janthaluru; the Central Tribal University moved from near Visakhapatnam to Vizianagaram.

nd12d771687f.s:
Assertion (A): The Visakhapatnam node of VCIC, with its Rambilli and Nakkapalli clusters, accounts for about 49% of the corridor's output.
Reason (R): Trunk infrastructure at the Kopparthy node is funded through JICA.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nd12d771687f.x: A is correct; R is false because Kopparthy's trunk infrastructure comes through NICDIT (JICA backs CBIC).

nd94991efb25.s: The executing agency of the Vizag-Chennai Industrial Corridor in Andhra Pradesh is:
nd94991efb25.x: The Department of Industries and Commerce is the executing agency; APIIC, APRDC and AP Transco are among the four PIUs.

n11e7c0304fb.s: How many new parks have been proposed in Andhra Pradesh under the BHAVYA park scheme?
n11e7c0304fb.x: Six new AP parks are proposed under BHAVYA (2026-27 to 2031-32, Rs 33,660 crore, 100 parks nationally).

nb0a9ec5df7c.s: The Vizag-Chennai Industrial Corridor forms the first phase of the:
nb0a9ec5df7c.x: The roughly 800 km VCIC is the first phase of the East Coast Economic Corridor.

n036c8382b0c.s: The greenfield Bengaluru–Chennai Expressway starts at ____ in Karnataka.
n036c8382b0c.x: The expressway, built under Bharatmala Pariyojana Phase-I, starts at Hoskote in Karnataka.

n78f1f4a2198.s: The Delhi-Mumbai Industrial Corridor runs along which Dedicated Freight Corridor?
n78f1f4a2198.x: DMIC runs on the Western DFC with Japanese aid, while VCIC is ADB-funded and port-led.

na5fa749d4a5.s: Industrial parks under the AP Industrial Corridor Development Authority are notified under ____ of the AP-ICDA Act, 2017.
na5fa749d4a5.x: Parks are notified under Section 3 of the AP-ICDA Act, 2017, not Section 5.

n63027201262.s: Which three industrial corridors are being implemented in Andhra Pradesh?
o: VCIC, CBIC and Hyderabad-Bengaluru Industrial Corridor
CBIC, East Coast Economic Corridor and Delhi-Mumbai Corridor
n63027201262.x: The three corridors in AP are VCIC, CBIC and the Hyderabad-Bengaluru Industrial Corridor.

n8bb6e4ff90b.s:
Assertion (A): Special Category Status is not expressly provided for in the Constitution of India.
Reason (R): It was an executive and Planning Commission-era classification.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n8bb6e4ff90b.x: SCS is not a constitutional category because it arose as an executive, Planning Commission-era classification linked to preferential Plan assistance.

n277dcd30196.s: Which Finance Commission added a 10 per cent 'Contribution to GDP' criterion while retaining the 41 per cent share?
n277dcd30196.x: The Sixteenth FC kept 41 per cent and added a Contribution to GDP criterion; the Fourteenth gave 42 and the Fifteenth 41 per cent.

n771df975e0e.s: Central loans to Special Category States carried ____ interest.
n771df975e0e.x: SCS States got Central loans at concessional interest, while general States got normal terms.

n243ee68c598.s: Which of the following States received Special Category Status?
n243ee68c598.x: Uttarakhand was among the SCS States; Bihar, Odisha and Andhra Pradesh were never granted it despite their demands.

n9534e50cb0d.s: In which year was the Special Assistance Package offered to Andhra Pradesh?
n9534e50cb0d.x: The package came in September 2016, after the 2014 Rajya Sabha assurance and the 2015 Fourteenth FC award, and before TDP left the NDA in 2018.

n7e5f4326fd0.s: Why did Andhra Pradesh say the Fourteenth Finance Commission's 42 per cent devolution did not meet its SCS concerns?
o: It applied to all States and did not address AP's asymmetric loss of Hyderabad
It replaced the AP Reorganisation Act entirely
It was available only to States with international borders
It applied only to Andhra Pradesh
n7e5f4326fd0.x: The 42 per cent devolution applied uniformly to all States, so it did not compensate AP for its asymmetric loss of Hyderabad.

nef91ec254e7.s: The Sixteenth Finance Commission gave the 'Contribution to GDP' criterion a weight of:
nef91ec254e7.x: The Sixteenth Finance Commission added Contribution to GDP as a criterion with a 10 per cent weight.

n854adabe590.s:
Assertion (A): Under the Special Assistance Package, Polavaram was treated as a national project under Section 90.
Reason (R): The package's industrial incentives were linked to Section 94(1).
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n854adabe590.x: Both are correct parts of the package, but the Section 94(1) industrial incentives have nothing to do with Polavaram's national project status under Section 90.

nb5db04fe058.s: The Special Assistance Package for Andhra Pradesh, in place of SCS, was announced in September 2016 by:
nb5db04fe058.x: Union Finance Minister Arun Jaitley announced the package (also called SAM) in September 2016; Manmohan Singh gave the 2014 Rajya Sabha assurance on SCS.

nc0f6de7b58f.s: Unlike SCS funds, funds under Andhra Pradesh's Special Assistance Package were tied to:
nc0f6de7b58f.x: SCS funds could be used across all schemes, while the executive package's funds were tied to approved externally aided projects.

nd8eab016b8c.s: The total Special Assistance Measure announced for Andhra Pradesh was:
nd8eab016b8c.x: The measure totalled ₹24,350 crore, of which ₹3,979 crore was the revenue deficit grant and the rest for infrastructure.

n0b3dc316183.s: The Scheme for Special Assistance to States for Capital Investment (SASCI) began in:
n0b3dc316183.x: SASCI, run by the Ministry of Finance with 50-year interest-free loans for capital works, began in October 2020.

nf5b5f055ae4.s: Under the Externally Aided Projects route for Andhra Pradesh, the Centre repays loan and interest up to:
o: The full loan without any limit
nf5b5f055ae4.x: The State borrows from agencies like the World Bank and ADB, and the Centre repays loan and interest up to the SCS-equivalent amount.

n022f7beaf37.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the revolution of the planets?
o: All eight planets revolve counter-clockwise when viewed from above the Sun's north pole
The period of revolution generally increases with distance from the Sun
An outer planet has a shorter period of revolution than every inner planet
Mercury has the shortest period of revolution
n022f7beaf37.x: Planets farther from the Sun generally take longer to revolve, so an outer planet's period is longer, not shorter.

n77db9da1aa9.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Aditya-L1 – Solar observatory at Sun-Earth L1
SMILE – Imaging solar wind interaction with Earth's magnetic shield
n77db9da1aa9.x: Mangalyaan is India's Mars orbiter, not a lunar orbiter; the other pairs are correct.

n13f63ab6a22.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Big Bang theory?
o: Hubble's 1929 red-shift of receding galaxies indicates an expanding universe
Cosmic Microwave Background radiation is its leftover glow
It was proposed by Georges Lemaitre in 1927
It was first proposed by Hoyle, Bondi and Gold in 1948
n13f63ab6a22.x: Hoyle, Bondi and Gold (1948) proposed the Steady State theory; the Big Bang was proposed by Lemaitre (1927).

n2a16fa78f01.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Hera – Survey of Didymos-Dimorphos after DART
n2a16fa78f01.x: Hayabusa2 obtained samples from asteroid Ryugu, not Bennu; Bennu samples came from OSIRIS-REx.

nd5d97bdddf8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the present view of planet formation?
o: The hot inner region of the disc mainly retained water, ammonia and methane ices
The planets formed from the same spinning protoplanetary disc as the Sun
The hot inner region retained metals and rocky minerals in solid form
Volatile ices were retained mainly in the cool outer region
nd5d97bdddf8.x: Ices were retained in the cool outer disc (linked to giant planets); the hot inner disc kept only metals and rocky minerals.

n805579c7ab9.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Aditya-L1?
o: It operates in a halo orbit at Sun-Earth L1
It is about 1.5 million km from Earth
Its VELC payload made the first X-ray images of the solar wind striking Earth's magnetic shield
Its data decoded how the October 2024 solar storm compressed Earth's magnetic field
n805579c7ab9.x: VELC made the first visible-light spectroscopic observations of CMEs; it did not make X-ray images of the solar wind hitting the magnetic shield.

ngeneral-geography-1-71.s: A Full Moon occurring when the Moon is at perigee is called a:
ngeneral-geography-1-71.x: Perigee is the Moon's closest point to Earth, so a Full Moon at perigee appears as a Supermoon.

ngeneral-geography-1-50.s: The Sun's diameter is about ____ times that of the Earth.
ngeneral-geography-1-50.x: The Sun is about 109 times Earth's diameter and holds 99.8% of the Solar System's mass.

ngeneral-geography-1-14.s: A meteoroid that survives its passage through the atmosphere and reaches the Earth's surface is called a:
ngeneral-geography-1-14.x: The piece that lands is a meteorite; the meteor is the bright streak, and the meteoroid the body in space.

ne6a58d52d91.s: The Earth reaches perihelion, about 147 million km from the Sun, around:
ne6a58d52d91.x: Perihelion is around 3 January (~147 million km) and aphelion around 4 July (~152 million km).

ngeneral-geography-3-50.s: The Earth's perihelion falls during which season of the Northern Hemisphere?
ngeneral-geography-3-50.x: Perihelion (minimum Earth-Sun distance) occurs during northern winter, and aphelion during northern summer.

ngeneral-geography-2-36.s: The Earth's aphelion distance from the Sun is approximately:
ngeneral-geography-2-36.x: At aphelion Earth is farthest from the Sun, about 152 million km; perihelion is about 147 million km.

n899c8338e9a.s: Because of its suitable distance from the Sun, the Earth lies in the Sun's:
n899c8338e9a.x: Earth lies in the Sun's habitable zone; with liquid water and a protective atmosphere this explains its known habitability.

na61513cb7c9.s: Methane contributes to the blue-green appearance of:
na61513cb7c9.x: Methane gives Uranus and Neptune their blue-green tints; Jupiter and Saturn are mostly hydrogen and helium.

ngeneral-geography-1-83.s: Halley's Comet, last seen in 1986, is next expected to appear in:
ngeneral-geography-1-83.x: Halley's Comet was last seen in 1986 and returns in 2061.

n82354abdefc.s: Which planet rotates nearly on its side?
n82354abdefc.x: Uranus rotates nearly on its side; Venus shows retrograde rotation.

n09917ef46c6.s: Sunspots are markers of a solar cycle of approximately:
n09917ef46c6.x: Sunspots, cooler dark magnetic patches, mark the ~11-year solar cycle, at whose peak the Sun's magnetic poles reverse.

n5e1da666a85.s: Absolute magnitude is the brightness a star would have at a standard distance of:
n5e1da666a85.x: Absolute magnitude is defined at 10 parsecs; on the logarithmic magnitude scale a lower number means a brighter star.

n752dd1fe555.s: Titan, a moon with a dense atmosphere and lakes of liquid methane, belongs to:
n752dd1fe555.x: Titan is Saturn's moon with a dense atmosphere and methane lakes about 100 m deep.

n195a1402cc7.s: On 3I/ATLAS, JWST detected which substance, a first for an interstellar object?
n195a1402cc7.x: JWST detected methane on 3I/ATLAS, a first for an interstellar object; water's signature was found by NASA.

ngeneral-geography-1-73.x: Comets are ice, dust and rock on highly elliptical orbits; asteroids are rock and metal on less eccentric orbits.

n6dd768cf2ba.s: A bright meteor that explodes in the air is called a:
n6dd768cf2ba.x: A bolide is a bright meteor that explodes in the air; a meteorite is the fragment that reaches the ground.

ngeneral-geography-1-52.s: The southern aurora is known as:
ngeneral-geography-1-52.x: The southern aurora is Aurora Australis and the northern aurora is Aurora Borealis.

n915c3061d6f.s: The source of long-period comets is the:
n915c3061d6f.x: The distant Oort cloud feeds long-period comets; the Kuiper belt (30-50 AU) feeds short-period comets.

ngeneral-geography-1-9.x: William Herschel found Uranus; Tombaugh found Pluto, Kepler gave the three laws and Copernicus the heliocentric model.

n542a5b860b0.s: Sunlight takes about how long to reach the Earth?
n542a5b860b0.x: Light covers the ~150 million km (1 AU) in about 8 min 20 s.

n98fcc341cce.s: The two natural satellites of Mars are:
n98fcc341cce.x: Mars has two moons, Phobos and Deimos; Mercury and Venus have none and Earth has one.

ngeneral-geography-1-4.s: The brightest planet in the sky is:
ngeneral-geography-1-4.x: Venus is the brightest planet; Mercury is nearest the Sun, Jupiter largest and Neptune farthest.

n195e7cc3905.s: Polaris, the star within about one degree of the north celestial pole, lies in the constellation:
n195e7cc3905.x: Polaris is in Ursa Minor and lies close to the north celestial pole.

n6084f63ced8.s: The first mathematically predictive heliocentric model is associated with:
n6084f63ced8.x: That model is associated with Copernicus; Aryabhata held that the Earth rotates on its axis and explained eclipses.

n8618990fbbd.x: Launched by PSLV-C25 in November 2013, Mangalyaan reached Mars orbit on 24 September 2014, making India the first Asian nation to reach Mars.

n733badcf431.s: The largest moon of Pluto is:

ngeneral-geography-1-54.s: One astronomical unit, the mean Earth-Sun distance, is about:
ngeneral-geography-1-54.x: One AU is 149.6 million km (149.6 × 10⁹ m), which light crosses in about 8 min 19 s.

na60b8e33624.s: Oxygen was added to the Earth's early atmosphere mainly through:
na60b8e33624.x: After the hydrogen-helium atmosphere was lost and degassing supplied water vapour, nitrogen and CO2, photosynthesis added oxygen.

ngeneral-geography-1-49.s: The source of the Sun's energy is:
o: Nuclear fusion of hydrogen into helium
ngeneral-geography-1-49.x: In the Sun's plasma core (~15 million °C), fusion turns hydrogen into helium and releases energy.

ngeneral-geography-1-21.s: Which is the outermost of the inner planets?
ngeneral-geography-1-21.x: The inner planets in order are Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars; Jupiter is the first outer planet.

o: The Moon is between the Sun and the Earth
The Earth is between the Sun and the Moon
ngeneral-geography-1-70.x: At new Moon, the Moon lies between the Sun and Earth; Earth between Sun and Moon gives a full Moon and a 90° angle gives a half Moon.

ngeneral-geography-1-74.s: When a comet nears the Sun, its tail points:
ngeneral-geography-1-74.x: Comets develop tails near the Sun, and the tails point away from the Sun; asteroids generally lack tails.

ngeneral-geography-1-17.s: Halley's Comet is a short-period comet with a period of about:
ngeneral-geography-1-17.x: Halley's period is about 76 years; Hale-Bopp is a long-period comet of about 2,534 years.

o: The Moon's shadow falls on the Earth
The Moon lies between the Sun and the Earth
The Earth's shadow falls on the Moon
ngeneral-geography-1-67.x: In a lunar eclipse Earth's shadow falls on the Moon; in a solar eclipse the Moon's shadow falls on Earth.

ngeneral-geography-1-15.s: Uranus and Neptune are known as:
ngeneral-geography-1-15.x: Uranus and Neptune are ice giants, while Jupiter and Saturn are gas giants.

ngeneral-geography-1-81.s: The densest planet of the Solar System is:
ngeneral-geography-1-81.x: Earth is the densest planet, at about 5.5 g/cm³.

ngeneral-geography-2-14.s: The Earth's orbital speed is greatest at:
ngeneral-geography-2-14.x: Earth moves fastest at perihelion (early January) and slowest at aphelion (early July).

ngeneral-geography-1-20.s: What provides the centripetal force that keeps the planets in closed orbits around the Sun?
ngeneral-geography-1-20.x: The Sun's gravity supplies the centripetal force; without it a planet would fly off in a straight line.

ngeneral-geography-2-37.s: Which law explains why the Earth moves fastest at perihelion and slowest at aphelion?
ngeneral-geography-2-37.x: Kepler's second law: equal areas are swept in equal times, so Earth moves faster near the Sun.

nedd01bb8239.s: The Steady State theory of the universe was formulated in:
nedd01bb8239.x: The Steady State theory dates to 1948, after the Nebular (1755), Planetesimal (1904) and Big Bang (1927) theories.

nb57c76766e9.s: Which of the following is the largest unit of distance?
nb57c76766e9.x: A parsec is about 3.26 light-years, and a light-year is far larger than an AU.

n39badea32c9.s: Which colour of star has the highest surface temperature?
n39badea32c9.x: Blue stars are the hottest and red stars the coolest; the Sun is a yellow star.

n7d0f40d30c6.s: A 2026 study found that some geomagnetic pole reversals lasted up to about:
n7d0f40d30c6.x: The 2026 study found some reversals lasted up to about 70,000 years, against the assumed 10,000 years.

na7827ec6791.s: Which planet has recorded the lowest single temperature, about −224°C?
na7827ec6791.x: Uranus recorded the lowest single temperature (about −224°C), while Neptune has the lowest average temperature (about −200°C).

n2e819d2144b.s: The temperature of the Sun's photosphere is about:
n2e819d2144b.x: The photosphere is about 5,500–6,000°C, while the corona, though farther out, can exceed one million °C.

ngeneral-geography-3-43.s: Which of the following is NOT correct?
o: The Tropics of Cancer and Capricorn are 47° apart
The noon altitude of the Sun at the Tropic of Cancer at the December solstice is 47°
The Tropic of Cancer is 23½° from the Equator
ngeneral-geography-3-43.x: At the December solstice the noon Sun at the Tropic of Cancer stands at 90° − 47° = 43°, not 47°.

n089a032c499.s: Which of the following is evidence of the spherical shape of the Earth?
o: The Earth's circular shadow on the Moon during a lunar eclipse
Equal day and night at the equinoxes
n089a032c499.x: The circular lunar-eclipse shadow, like the mast-first view of ships, circumnavigation and satellite images, shows the Earth is spherical.

nfa2801b4223.s: The 'Correct the Map' campaign against the Mercator projection was backed by:
nfa2801b4223.x: The African Union backed 'Correct the Map'; the resulting UNGA resolution was non-binding (India for, US against).

ncc2d16fe793.x: India measures about 3,214 km north-south and 2,933 km east-west, with an area of about 32,87,263 sq km.

nead2c6d1626.x: Geoid means 'earth-shaped'; the Earth is an oblate spheroid, flattened at the poles and bulging at the Equator.

n7133d251209.s: Gerardus Mercator developed the Mercator projection in:
n7133d251209.x: The Mercator projection (1569) has right-angled graticule, straight rhumb lines and enlarged polar areas.

nc9ee24f1ab9.s: The mean radius of the Earth is approximately:
nc9ee24f1ab9.x: Earth's mean radius is about 6,371 km; the equatorial diameter exceeds the polar diameter by about 43 km.

nff587fda7bf.s: EOS-05, India's first Earth-imaging satellite in geosynchronous orbit, orbits about how high above the Earth?
nff587fda7bf.x: EOS-05 is in geosynchronous orbit about 36,000 km up, allowing frequent views of the same area.

ngeneral-geography-1-38.s: The equatorial diameter of the Earth is about:
ngeneral-geography-1-38.x: The equatorial diameter is 12,756 km and the polar diameter 12,714 km; the equatorial circumference is about 40,090 km.

nea375b494a5.s: Which State borders Andhra Pradesh on the south-west?
nea375b494a5.x: Karnataka lies to the south-west of AP; Tamil Nadu is to the south, Telangana to the west and north-west, and Chhattisgarh and Odisha to the north.

n285255da357.s: The coastline of Andhra Pradesh is about:
n285255da357.x: AP has a coastline of about 974 km and an area of about 1,62,970 sq km (~4.96% of India).

n9624215d8b5.s: The Tropic of Cancer passes through how many Indian States?
n9624215d8b5.x: It crosses 8 States: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura and Mizoram (not Odisha).

n948552c0de3.s: Andhra Pradesh, lying wholly between the Equator and the Tropic of Cancer, has a tropical climate of the type:
n948552c0de3.x: Andhra Pradesh is described as having a tropical Aw climate.

nworld-geography-3-5.s: Who was the first person to reach the South Pole, in 1911?
nworld-geography-3-5.x: Roald Amundsen reached the South Pole in 1911; Peary's claim to the North Pole is disputed.

n9a975f7aaf9.s: As of 2025, how many districts does Andhra Pradesh have?
n9a975f7aaf9.x: AP had 13 districts in 2014, 26 in 2022 and 28 in 2025.

n4dcbf55e1b4.s: One degree of longitude at 60° latitude represents a distance of about:
n4dcbf55e1b4.x: Because meridians converge, one degree of longitude is about 111 km at the Equator, 55.5 km at 60° and zero at the poles.

naedfafa8bfc.s: The easternmost point of India is:
naedfafa8bfc.x: Kibithu in Arunachal Pradesh is India's easternmost point; Guhar Moti in Gujarat is the westernmost.

n503b5a8e788.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the effects of the Earth's rotation?
o: The Coriolis force deflects winds and currents to the right in the Northern Hemisphere
The Coriolis force deflects winds and currents to the left in the Northern Hemisphere
The Coriolis force deflects winds and currents to the left in the Southern Hemisphere
Rotation contributes to the flattening of the Earth at the poles
n503b5a8e788.x: In the Northern Hemisphere the Coriolis deflection is to the right, not the left; deflection is to the left only in the Southern Hemisphere.

n0e6375dbdd7.s: Climate-driven melting of ice is lengthening the Earth's day by about how much per century?
n0e6375dbdd7.x: Melting ice shifts mass towards the Equator, raising the moment of inertia and lengthening the day by about 1.33 ms per century.

ngeneral-geography-2-18.s: The linear speed of the Earth's rotation is maximum at the:
ngeneral-geography-2-18.x: Linear rotational speed is greatest at the Equator and zero at the poles.

ngeneral-geography-2-23.s: The centrifugal effect of the Earth's rotation results in:
ngeneral-geography-2-23.x: Rotation's centrifugal effect is greatest at the Equator and zero at the poles, causing polar flattening.

nc04267294b3.s: The Coriolis force is maximum at the:
nc04267294b3.x: The Coriolis force (2Ωv sin latitude) is zero at the Equator, maximum at the poles and grows with wind velocity.

n28417f6b920.s: The circle of illumination passes through both poles at the:
n28417f6b920.x: The circle of illumination (grey line) divides day from night and passes through both poles only at the equinoxes.

ngeneral-geography-3-17.s: The six-month polar day and night is caused by:
ngeneral-geography-3-17.x: Revolution with axial tilt causes seasons, solstices and equinoxes, opposite seasons in the hemispheres and six-month polar day and night.

ngeneral-geography-2-16.s: Which of the following is NOT primarily associated with the Earth's rotation?
ngeneral-geography-2-16.x: Perihelion and aphelion belong to revolution; day and night, the Coriolis effect and time zones come from rotation.

o: North of the Arctic Circle and south of the Antarctic Circle
Between the Tropic of Cancer and the Arctic Circle
ngeneral-geography-3-39.x: The midnight sun occurs beyond the polar circles, peaking near each summer solstice, as in Norway.

ngeneral-geography-2-19.s: Day and night on the Earth are caused by its:
ngeneral-geography-2-19.x: Rotation, not revolution or tilt, causes day and night; the circle of illumination divides the two halves.

ngeneral-geography-2-44.s: Shifts in the Earth's rotational axis are mainly driven by:
o: Redistribution of mass, such as melting ice and groundwater depletion
ngeneral-geography-2-44.x: Mass redistribution from melting ice and groundwater use shifts the axis; solar flares only disturb the upper atmosphere.

ngeneral-geography-2-38.s: The extra fraction of a day in each calendar year, which adds up to a leap day in four years, is about:
ngeneral-geography-2-38.x: The extra quarter day accumulates to one day in four years, giving a 366-day leap year with 29 February.

ngeneral-geography-2-17.s: The spinning of the Earth on its own axis is called:
ngeneral-geography-2-17.x: Rotation is Earth's spin on its axis; revolution is its elliptical path around the Sun.

ngeneral-geography-2-25.s: The Earth takes about how many days to complete one revolution around the Sun?
ngeneral-geography-2-25.x: Earth takes about 365¼ days to complete one revolution on its elliptical orbit.

ngeneral-geography-3-15.s: At the Equator, seasons are marked mainly by:
ngeneral-geography-3-15.x: Day length hardly changes at the Equator, so it has wet and dry seasons rather than winter and summer.

n11e3d6ef22d.s: A cyclone approaching the Andhra Pradesh coast is usually steered towards the:
n11e3d6ef22d.x: Steering winds, trade winds and the Coriolis effect steer such cyclones north-northwest.

ngeneral-geography-2-59.s: The weight of an object on the Earth is minimum at the:
ngeneral-geography-2-59.x: The centrifugal effect of rotation is greatest at the Equator, so effective gravity and weight are least there.

ngeneral-geography-1-3.s: The Earth rotates on its axis from:
ngeneral-geography-1-3.x: Earth spins west to east once in 24 hours, turning each place toward and away from the Sun to give day and night.

ndbd7750db30.s: Approximately 12 hours of daylight throughout the year is experienced at the:
ndbd7750db30.x: The Equator has about 12-hour days all year; variation in day length increases with latitude.

na430c1cfbad.s: Under the Gregorian rule, which of the following century years was a leap year?
na430c1cfbad.x: A century year is a leap year only if divisible by 400, so 2000 was a leap year and 1900 was not.

ngeneral-geography-3-32.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: 21/22 December – Sun overhead at the Tropic of Cancer
21 March – Sun overhead at the Equator, moving northward
21 June – Sun overhead at the Tropic of Cancer, starting to move southward
23 September – Sun overhead at the Equator, moving southward
ngeneral-geography-3-32.x: On 21/22 December the Sun is overhead at the Tropic of Capricorn, not Cancer.

ngeneral-geography-3-25.s: Which of the following pairs about the June solstice is NOT correctly matched?
o: Northern Hemisphere – Longest day and shortest night
ngeneral-geography-3-25.x: At the June solstice the North Pole has continuous daylight, not darkness.

nc56457d52c3.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, 2026?
o: They were notified by the Ministry of Consumer Affairs
They make IST the single mandatory reference for legal, administrative, commercial and official purposes
They came into force immediately on notification
nc56457d52c3.x: The Rules come into force 180 days after Gazette publication, not immediately.

na93abcd69b1.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the White Rabbit-based IST Distribution Demonstration Network?
o: It was inaugurated at RRSL, Jakkur (Bengaluru)
Its White Rabbit protocol was developed by ISRO
It gives sub-nanosecond synchronisation over fibre
na93abcd69b1.x: The White Rabbit protocol was developed by CERN, not ISRO.

n6eedc295452.s: Which of the following is NOT a consequence of the Earth's axial tilt?
o: Unequal length of day and night
Location of the polar circles at about 66½°
n6eedc295452.x: Day and night are caused by rotation; the tilt gives seasons, unequal day length and the positions of the tropics and polar circles.

n210ecf83b07.s: India's single time zone mainly costs which region daylight hours?
n210ecf83b07.x: India's wide east-west extent leaves the north-east at a daylight disadvantage; separate-zone proposals remain undecided.

nindian-geography-47-18.s: Fifteen degrees of longitude correspond to how much time?
nindian-geography-47-18.x: 15° equals one hour and 1° equals 4 minutes; IST (82°30′E) is GMT + 5 h 30 min.

ngeneral-geography-3-62.s: Day and night are approximately equal at:
ngeneral-geography-3-62.x: An equinox is a seasonal transition with about equal day and night; a solstice has unequal day and night and maximum seasonal contrast.

nindian-geography-45-4.s: Of the States crossed by the Tropic of Cancer, which is first in the west-to-east order?
nindian-geography-45-4.x: West to east, Gujarat is first, Madhya Pradesh third, Jharkhand fifth and Tripura seventh.

n56224144119.s: The winter solstice in the Northern Hemisphere occurs around:
n56224144119.x: The northern winter solstice is around 22 December and the autumnal equinox around 22 or 23 September.

nad86eee7986.s: The International Date Line passes through the:
nad86eee7986.x: The Date Line passes through the Bering Strait and deviates around the Aleutians and Pacific island groups.

n5235e58c520.s: The poles experience about how long a period of continuous daylight?
n5235e58c520.x: The poles have roughly six months of day and six months of night.

nc894ea3a8a8.s: On 21 June, daylight at the Tropic of Cancer lasts about:
nc894ea3a8a8.x: On 21 June the Tropic of Cancer has about 13.5 h of daylight, the Arctic Circle 24 h and the Equator about 12 h.

n9384d02647c.s: One minute of arc of longitude corresponds to:
n9384d02647c.x: 15° = 1 hour and 1° = 4 minutes, so one minute of arc equals 4 seconds of time.

ne958281fff1.s: A weather balloon launched at 0000 UTC goes up at what Indian Standard Time?
ne958281fff1.x: IST (82°30′E) is 5 h 30 min ahead of GMT, so 0000 UTC is 5:30 a.m. IST.

ngeneral-geography-3-34.s: From 23 September to 21 December, days in the Northern Hemisphere:
ngeneral-geography-3-34.x: In this period northern days shorten while southern days lengthen; the reverse happens from December to March.

ndd4eb7d4922.x: NavIC (7 satellites: 3 GEO + 4 GSO) uses rubidium atomic clocks; the clock on IRNSS-1F failed.

ngeneral-geography-2-13.s: On 21/22 December, the Southern Hemisphere has its:
ngeneral-geography-2-13.x: On 21/22 December the Southern Hemisphere has its longest day; on 21 June the Northern Hemisphere does.

ngeneral-geography-2-27.s: During the March Equinox, which season begins in the Southern Hemisphere?
ngeneral-geography-2-27.x: At the March Equinox spring begins in the Northern Hemisphere and autumn in the Southern Hemisphere.

ngeneral-geography-1-5.s: On 23 September, the Sun is overhead at the:
ngeneral-geography-1-5.x: On 23 September (and 21 March) the Sun is overhead at the Equator.

n33cfa11fd3c.s: Separate Bombay and Calcutta times were introduced in:
n33cfa11fd3c.x: Bombay and Calcutta times date from 1884; a single IST was adopted after 1947.

ngeneral-geography-2-12.x: Local time advances eastward, so moving west it falls behind (15° = one hour).

nindian-geography-45-20.s: The Mahi river, which crosses the Tropic of Cancer twice, drains into the:
nindian-geography-45-20.x: The Mahi rises in Madhya Pradesh, flows through Rajasthan and Gujarat and drains into the Gulf of Khambhat.

ngeneral-geography-2-32.s: When the North Pole has six months of continuous daylight, the South Pole has:
ngeneral-geography-2-32.x: Axial inclination and revolution give the poles opposite six-month patterns of day and night.

ngeneral-geography-2-6.s: Seasons occur because of the Earth's revolution combined with its:
ngeneral-geography-2-6.x: The axial tilt changes the Sun's angle and day length as Earth revolves, producing seasons.

ngeneral-geography-2-8.s: The Earth's axis keeps approximately the same orientation during its revolution because of:
ngeneral-geography-2-8.x: Angular momentum keeps the axis parallel to itself; opposite seasons are a result of this, not its cause.

nindian-geography-47-16.s: When crossing the International Date Line (about 180°) eastward, one must:
nindian-geography-47-16.x: Crossing the Date Line eastward means subtracting a day.

ngeneral-geography-3-18.s: The Earth's axis is inclined to the plane of its orbit at:
ngeneral-geography-3-18.x: The axis makes 66½° with the orbital plane, which is a 23½° tilt from the perpendicular.

n73555956d55.s: On 22 December, the North Pole experiences:
n73555956d55.x: The North Pole has continuous night at the December solstice, continuous day at the June solstice and sunrise or sunset at an equinox.

nb2e7739ef4f.s: Which Pacific country moved to the Asian side of the International Date Line in 2011?
nb2e7739ef4f.x: Samoa shifted to the Asian side of the Date Line in 2011, changing its calendar relation with neighbours.

nae87856f10a.s: With respect to the Tropic of Cancer, Andhra Pradesh lies:
o: Crossed by it in its northern part
Along it, on its northern boundary
nae87856f10a.x: Andhra Pradesh lies wholly south of the Tropic of Cancer.

n477c8d4905e.s: Daylight Saving Time is mainly intended to:
o: Align a country's time with GMT
Make more use of evening daylight in summer
n477c8d4905e.x: DST makes better use of evening daylight in summer; India does not use it.

ngeneral-geography-3-22.s: The summer hemisphere is the one that is:
ngeneral-geography-3-22.x: The summer hemisphere tilts towards the Sun, getting concentrated energy, a higher Sun and longer days.

n715a1cd23de.s: Four distinct seasons are generally experienced in:
n715a1cd23de.x: Mid-latitudes show four distinct seasons; low latitudes have wet and dry periods and subtropics hot summers and mild winters.

ngeneral-geography-3-10.s: At the December solstice, the Sun is overhead at the:
ngeneral-geography-3-10.x: At the December solstice the Sun is over Capricorn; at the June solstice over Cancer; at the equinoxes over the Equator.

n00837821c3e.s: In 1935, a temperature of about 50°C was recorded at:
n00837821c3e.x: About 50°C was recorded at Ganganagar in 1935, during the March-May hot weather season.

nbc4552262d0.s: Which is the coldest place in Andhra Pradesh?
nbc4552262d0.x: Lambasingi is the coldest place in AP (about 2°C), not the hottest.

n027312953b2.s: When the Northern Hemisphere is tilted towards the Sun, it experiences:
n027312953b2.x: The hemisphere tilted towards the Sun gets more direct rays and longer days, producing summer.

n5e9919eac3e.s: The seasons on the Earth are caused mainly by:
n5e9919eac3e.x: Seasons come mainly from axial tilt affecting solar angle and day length; Earth is in fact nearest the Sun during northern winter.

ngeneral-geography-3-8.s: The summer hemisphere receives greater heating than the winter hemisphere because:
o: It is nearer to the Sun
Its solar rays are more oblique
Its solar rays are more direct and its days are longer
ngeneral-geography-3-8.x: Direct rays and longer days give the summer hemisphere more heating.

na5d18d6d37e.s: On 21 June, which of the following cities has the longest day?
na5d18d6d37e.x: On 21 June day length increases northward: Srinagar > Delhi > Hyderabad > Chennai > Kanyakumari.

ngeneral-geography-3-45.s: More oblique solar rays produce lower heating because they:
o: Spread the same energy over a larger area
ngeneral-geography-3-45.x: Oblique rays spread the same energy over a larger area, so heating per unit area is lower.

n419243c65a3.s: Under the IMD's seasonal classification, which season follows the South-West monsoon?
n419243c65a3.x: IMD's four seasons run winter, pre-monsoon, South-West monsoon and post-monsoon.

n63350563f4b.s: The Southern Hemisphere has its longest day around:
n63350563f4b.x: The Southern Hemisphere's longest day is around 22 December, while the Northern Hemisphere's is around 21 June.

nacd0cec50a2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Earth's core?
o: The outer core extends from about 2,900 km to 5,150 km
The inner core extends from about 5,150 km to the centre at 6,371 km
nacd0cec50a2.x: The inner core is solid; only the outer core is liquid.

nd746c471b5d.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about sources of information on the Earth's interior?
o: Meteorites provide direct evidence of the interior
Meteorites are used because they are made of material similar to the Earth's
Magma and lava from volcanic eruptions give direct evidence
nd746c471b5d.x: Meteorites are an indirect source; only material such as magma and lava gives direct evidence.

n8d2637ecc2d.s: The asthenosphere is located in the:
n8d2637ecc2d.x: The asthenosphere is a weak, partly molten upper-mantle zone at about 100–200 km and a major source of magma.

ngeneral-geography-4-23.s: The lithosphere is made up of the:
ngeneral-geography-4-23.x: The rigid lithosphere is made of the crust and uppermost mantle, above the weak, ductile asthenosphere.

ngeneral-geography-4-6.x: Gutenberg separates mantle and outer core; Moho, crust and mantle; Lehmann, outer and inner core; Conrad, upper and lower crust.

ngeneral-geography-4-36.s: The average density of the Earth is approximately:
ngeneral-geography-4-36.x: Earth averages about 5.5 g/cm³, the densest planet, with density increasing inward.

n6b113f70cbc.s: S-waves are absent everywhere beyond about ____ from the epicentre.
n6b113f70cbc.x: S-waves are absent beyond 105°, so the S-wave shadow zone is larger than the P-wave shadow zone.

ngeneral-geography-4-11.s: The P-wave shadow zone lies approximately between:
ngeneral-geography-4-11.x: The P-wave shadow zone is about 103°–142° from the epicentre.

ngeneral-geography-4-15.s: The layer lying directly below the mantle is the:
ngeneral-geography-4-15.x: The crust is outermost, then the mantle, then the outer core, with the inner core at the centre.

ngeneral-geography-4-26.s: Surface seismic waves are also called:
ngeneral-geography-4-26.x: Surface waves are L-waves; P-waves are primary and S-waves secondary waves.

ne5449845d5a.s: The Mohorovicic Discontinuity, separating the crust from the mantle, was discovered in:
ne5449845d5a.x: Andrija Mohorovicic identified it in 1909; it lies about 30 km below continents and 5 km below oceans.

n745167af499.s: The deepest hole, about 12 km deep, was drilled by the USSR in the 1970s on the:
n745167af499.x: The ~12 km hole was drilled on the Kola Peninsula; the Mponeng and TauTona mines (South Africa) reach only about 3.9 km.

ngeneral-geography-4-5.x: Oceanic crust is basaltic, denser and richer in Fe–Mg, while continental crust is thicker and generally older.

ngeneral-geography-4-30.x: In P-waves particles vibrate parallel to propagation (push–pull); in S-waves they vibrate perpendicular (transverse).

ngeneral-geography-4-12.s: The Earth's magnetic field is generated by convection of conducting material in the:
ngeneral-geography-4-12.x: Convection in the liquid outer core generates the field, and changes in that flow are linked to field reversals.

n810cfd3f92b.s: In the sequence Lithosphere – Asthenosphere – Mesosphere – Barysphere, the barysphere represents the:
n810cfd3f92b.x: From the surface inward the layers are lithosphere, asthenosphere, mesosphere and barysphere, the last being the core.

ngeneral-geography-4-8.s: Lithospheric plates are able to move because they glide over the weak:
ngeneral-geography-4-8.x: The weak asthenosphere lets lithospheric plates glide, so mantle movement below can drive them.

ncc82a37f0c3.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Tertiary rock system of India?
o: It spans roughly the Eocene to Pliocene
The Himalayas were born during the Tertiary period
The Neyveli lignite belongs to the Gondwana system
The petroleum of Assam and Gujarat is associated with it
ncc82a37f0c3.x: Neyveli lignite is Tertiary, not Gondwana; the other statements about the Tertiary system are correct.

ngeneral-geography-4-41.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about rocks?
o: Igneous rocks form by cooling of magma or lava
Sedimentary rocks form through surface deposition
Metamorphic rocks are existing rocks altered by heat or pressure
Granite is extrusive igneous and basalt is intrusive igneous
ngeneral-geography-4-41.x: It is the reverse: granite is intrusive igneous and basalt is extrusive igneous.

n41e80566e91.s:
Assertion (A): The Deccan Trap patches of Andhra Pradesh are associated with black cotton soil.
Reason (R): The Deccan Trap patches consist of basalt.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n41e80566e91.x: The Deccan Trap patches are basalt, and that basalt is what is associated with black cotton soil, so R explains A.

n5b564545540.s: In the discontinuous branch of Bowen's reaction series, the first mineral to crystallise is:
n5b564545540.x: The discontinuous branch runs olivine → pyroxene → amphibole → biotite; mafic minerals form first at the highest temperature.

neb944bcb0a0.s: Gold mining is reviving in Andhra Pradesh's Dharwar greenstone belt at:
neb944bcb0a0.x: Gold mining is reviving at Ramagiri; Kadapa-Kurnool limestone makes Rayalaseema a cement hub.

n467d5982bdd.s: Muscovite belongs to which silicate class?
n467d5982bdd.x: Muscovite is a phyllosilicate; albite is a tectosilicate, hornblende a double-chain and augite a single-chain inosilicate.

n47d893cb606.s: Which of the following is a felsic extrusive igneous rock?
n47d893cb606.x: Rhyolite is felsic extrusive; granite is felsic intrusive, diorite intermediate intrusive and basalt mafic extrusive.

nf843e3af39c.s: In Suess's classification, the granitic continental layer of silicon and aluminium is called:
nf843e3af39c.x: SIAL (silicon-aluminium) is granitic and continental; SIMA is basaltic and NIFE the nickel-iron core.

nf4d735d62e9.s: The second-most abundant element in the Earth's crust by weight is:
nf4d735d62e9.x: Silicon ranks second at about 27.7%; iron is the second-most abundant metal (~5.0%).

n7c70c7f44f7.s: The geological time scale was developed in 1760 by:
n7c70c7f44f7.x: Arduino developed it in 1760; the Standard scale was set in Italy in 1881 and the Indian scale was advocated by T.H. Holland.

n4cea4234ca4.s: In the rock cycle, exposed metamorphic rocks can weather and become:
n4cea4234ca4.x: Exposed metamorphic rocks can weather into sediment; any rock type can be transformed into another.

nae297a15d87.s: Compared with Carboniferous coal, Gondwana coal is:
nae297a15d87.x: Gondwana coal is younger and has lower carbon content than Carboniferous coal, and is not confined to the Himalayas.

n4ad737a4597.s: The Ramagiri gold belt of Andhra Pradesh is associated with which formation?
n4ad737a4597.x: The Dharwar formation (schists and gneisses) occurs in Anantapuramu, Chittoor and YSR Kadapa and includes the Ramagiri gold belt.

n4067c6229f5.x: Limestone becomes marble; shale becomes slate, sandstone quartzite and coal graphite.

n574542fa5e2.s: The principal repositories of fossils are:
n574542fa5e2.x: Sedimentary rocks such as sandstone preserve fossils and hold coal, petroleum and natural gas.

n0c1dcd3d30b.s: The important agents of metamorphism are:
n0c1dcd3d30b.x: Heat and pressure transform igneous and sedimentary rocks; complete melting is not required and would lead to magma.

nd7da1343e3b.s: The Cuddapah and Vindhyan systems belong to the:
nd7da1343e3b.x: Cuddapah and Vindhyan are Purana (Proterozoic) systems with a broadly similar age span; Cuddapah is not Archaean.

n1872c002539.s: Which of the following is a coarse-grained intrusive igneous rock?
n1872c002539.x: Intrusive rocks cool slowly at depth, forming coarse grains, as in granite and gabbro.

nbf0f8c7255f.s: Which of the following Indian rock systems is the youngest?
nbf0f8c7255f.x: The broad order from older to younger is Archaean, Dharwar, Cuddapah, Gondwana, Deccan Trap and Tertiary.

n7a80b5a264a.s: In the rock cycle, deposited sediments become sedimentary rock through:
n7a80b5a264a.x: After weathering, erosion and deposition, lithification forms sedimentary rocks; heat and pressure then form metamorphic rocks and melting forms magma.

n9c5a11e29d2.s: Which group of Indian rocks contains abundant marine fossils?
n9c5a11e29d2.x: Dravidian (Palaeozoic) rocks have abundant marine fossils, while Archaean rocks formed before life and are generally fossil-free.

n38303caad74.s: The khondalites and charnockites of Andhra Pradesh are associated with the:
n38303caad74.x: They are Archaean rocks, over 2.5 billion years old, associated with the Eastern Ghats Mobile Belt.

n5a89cad3577.s: The Geological Survey of India, under the Ministry of Mines, was set up in:
n5a89cad3577.x: The GSI was set up in 1851 under the Ministry of Mines.

n0193a475a38.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Alps – Young fold mountains of Europe
Appalachians – Old fold mountains of North America
Rockies – Old fold mountains of North America
Urals – Old fold mountains along the Europe–Asia divide
n0193a475a38.x: The Rockies are young fold mountains of North America; the Appalachians are the old ones.

na6e40bdf9b1.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Himalayas?
o: The Siwaliks are the oldest Himalayan range
They were formed from sediments of the Tethys Sea
Their uplift is associated with the Eocene, Miocene and Pliocene epochs
Their formation began about 70 million years ago and continues at present
na6e40bdf9b1.x: The Siwaliks are the youngest Himalayan range, not the oldest.

n7f99ae54805.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
n7f99ae54805.x: The San Andreas Fault is a transform boundary, not a divergent one.

n124efa1da84.s:
Assertion (A): Earthquakes occur at convergent plate boundaries.
Reason (R): Friction associated with subduction can produce earthquakes.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n124efa1da84.x: Subduction-related friction is what produces earthquakes at convergent boundaries, so R explains A.

o: The gravity of the Sun and the Moon
na3ba43088b0.x: The pole-fleeing force was linked to Earth's rotation and the tidal force to the Sun and Moon; both were too weak, so the theory was not accepted.

n8cc53f43595.s: Normal and reversed magnetic polarity bands on either side of a mid-ocean ridge occur:
n8cc53f43595.x: Ridge rocks preserve the field of their time, giving alternating normal and reversed bands symmetrically on both sides.

n06315456683.s: The Indian Plate is moving northward at about:
n06315456683.x: The Indian Plate moves north at about 5 cm a year, so the young fold Himalayas are still rising.

n0ccf32808d3.s: In Holmes's convection-current theory, mantle convection is driven by heat from:
n0ccf32808d3.x: Radioactive heat drives convection; rising limbs split crust at ridges and sinking limbs drag plates at trenches.

n5d00ac4f386.s: The mega-ocean that surrounded Pangaea was:
n5d00ac4f386.x: Panthalassa surrounded Pangaea; the Tethys Sea lay between northern Laurasia and southern Gondwanaland.

n6c1e58da559.s: The Peninsular Plateau of India was part of the African landmass until the:
n6c1e58da559.x: The Peninsular Plateau, an old Gondwana shield, was part of the African landmass until the Cretaceous.

nb69c16b281d.s: Which of the following is an example of a block mountain in India?
nb69c16b281d.x: The Satpura is a block mountain, flanked by the rift valleys of the Narmada and Tapi.

ncb654e89eeb.s: The Himalayas and the Indo-Gangetic foreland basin are mainly explained by:
o: Collision of the Indian and Eurasian plates
ncb654e89eeb.x: The India-Eurasia collision explains the Himalayas, the Indo-Gangetic foreland basin and India's earthquake risk.
